final_answer: Kestrel does not offer self-hosted, on-premises, single-tenant, or customer-VPC deployment options [2]. Kestrel Insight is exclusively a multi-tenant SaaS platform hosted on AWS, using logical isolation enforced at the database, application, and storage layers [1][2]. Consequently, there are no dedicated private-cloud provisioning options or timelines available [2].
question: Our regulated business unit cannot use multi-tenant SaaS. Please describe the self-hosted or on-premises deployment options available for regulated customers, including any private-cloud or customer-VPC installation, and the timeline to provision one.
